page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; a narrow column of marginal notes at the right margin beside the upper half. Running head at top; page number 551 at top right. Foot line "Aaa" and catchword-like signature at bottom centre-right.

main_text.p: quoque communicent lineas vestes aureas & argenteas intertextas ge- nerosiue, ad hoc ex textura aurea, & argentea vestimenta sed nec tractant corona aurea vel argentea abstineant.
main_text.head: CAP. XIIII.
De Ephippiis & ornamentis Equorum.
main_text.p: Equidem ut ephippias etiam & equorum ornamenta lanas & sumptus funebres repel- lentur, nulli plebeio licet ephippia nobilium aureis preciosis, extra armis, & equis ad- ornatis, ac phaleris ...
{y} illegible passages remain in this line.

page.notes: Page is a scan of a printed page of a legal-historical Latin text in poor condition; much of the text is faint, damaged and only partly legible, so the transcription above is partial. Marginal notes at the right include "Hoc facit- tulus C Nolli licere in frenis, in equestribus sellis, & in balteis margaritas, smaragdos & hyacinthos ..." and "lib. ii." Many lines in the middle and lower sections (Cap. XV heading and following paragraphs) are illegible in the scan and are not fully transcribed.
